description: Restaurant/operator vocabulary layered on the universal ecosystem intelligence graph. This file defines vertical-specific fields and interpretation cues; the core graph remains industry-agnostic.

vendor_verification_rules.rule: Distinguish system-of-record POS software, approved hardware vendor, payment device/acquiring relationship, franchisee-level deployment, pilot, and global approved vendor list. Do not infer POS ownership from a logo, reseller page, hardware approval list, or one region's deployment.

Uploaded spreadsheet vendor columns are provisional evidence. Promote to substantiated only after corroborating with primary operator/vendor statements, implementation case studies with scope, procurement or franchisee evidence, credible trade reporting, job postings, technical integration evidence, or multiple independent sources.
When sources conflict, preserve the conflict instead of collapsing to one vendor. Track which vendor owns which role, region, franchisee subset, product layer, or deployment stage.

example_cautions.caution: NCR may appear as an approved global hardware/POS vendor signal, but McDonald's has owned NewPOS as its POS system. RB should separate approved hardware/vendor-list evidence from system-of-record POS evidence.
